verses.original: γὰρ Πᾶς ἀρχιερεὺς καθίσταται λαμβανόμενος ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ὑπὲρ ἀνθρώπων τὰ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν ἵνα προσφέρῃ τε δῶρά καὶ θυσίας ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: gar Pas archiereus kathistatai lambanomenos ex anthrōpōn hyper anthrōpōn ta pros ton Theon hina prospherē te dōra kai thysias hyper hamartiōn
verses.literal: - Every high priest is appointed vvv from among men to represent [them] in matters relating to - God to offer - gifts and sacrifices for sins

verses.original: δυνάμενος μετριοπαθεῖν τοῖς ἀγνοοῦσιν καὶ πλανωμένοις ἐπεὶ αὐτὸς καὶ περίκειται ἀσθένειαν
verses.transliteration: dynamenos metriopathein tois agnoousin kai planōmenois epei autos kai perikeitai astheneian
verses.literal: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided since he himself - is subject to weakness

verses.original: καὶ δι’ αὐτὴν ὀφείλει προσφέρειν περὶ οὕτως περὶ αὑτοῦ ἁμαρτιῶν καὶ καθὼς περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai di’ autēn opheilei prospherein peri houtōs peri hautou hamartiōn kai kathōs peri tou laou
verses.literal: - That is why . . . he is obligated to offer sacrifices - - for his own sins - as well as for [the sins of] the people

verses.original: Καὶ οὐχ τις λαμβάνει τὴν τιμήν ἑαυτῷ ἀλλὰ καλούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ καθώσπερ Ἀαρών καὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai ouch tis lambanei tēn timēn heautō alla kaloumenos hypo tou Theou kathōsper Aarōn kai
verses.literal: - No one takes [this] honor upon himself - he must be called by - God just as Aaron [was]

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἐδόξασεν ἑαυτὸν γενηθῆναι ἀρχιερέα ἀλλ’ ὁ λαλήσας πρὸς αὐτόν σύ εἶ μου Υἱός σήμερον ἐγὼ γεγέννηκά σε
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai ho Christos ouch edoxasen heauton genēthēnai archierea all’ ho lalēsas pros auton sy ei mou Huios sēmeron egō gegennēka se
verses.literal: So also - Christ {did} not take upon Himself the glory . . . of becoming a high priest but [He was called] by the [One who] said to Him You are My Son today I have become Your Father . . .

verses.original: καὶ Καθὼς ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ
verses.transliteration: kai Kathōs en heterō legei Sy hiereus eis ton aiōna kata tēn taxin Melchisedek
verses.literal: And . . . in another [passage] [God] says You [are] a priest vvv vvv forever in the order of Melchizedek

verses.original: Ὃς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς αὐτοῦ σαρκὸς προσενέγκας τε δεήσεις καὶ ἱκετηρίας μετὰ ἰσχυρᾶς κραυγῆς καὶ δακρύων πρὸς τὸν δυνάμενον σῴζειν αὐτὸν ἐκ θανάτου καὶ εἰσακουσθεὶς ἀπὸ τῆς εὐλαβείας
verses.transliteration: Hos en tais hēmerais tēs autou sarkos prosenenkas te deēseis kai hiketērias meta ischyras kraugēs kai dakryōn pros ton dynamenon sōzein auton ek thanatou kai eisakoustheis apo tēs eulabeias
verses.literal: - During the days of [Jesus’] earthly [life] He offered up - prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the [One who] could save Him from death and He was heard because of [His] reverence

verses.original: καίπερ ὢν Υἱός ἔμαθεν τὴν ὑπακοήν ἀφ’ ὧν ἔπαθεν
verses.transliteration: kaiper ōn Huios emathen tēn hypakoēn aph’ hōn epathen
verses.literal: Although He was a Son He learned - obedience from what He suffered

verses.original: καὶ τελειωθεὶς ἐγένετο αἴτιος αἰωνίου σωτηρίας πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai teleiōtheis egeneto aitios aiōniou sōtērias pasin tois hypakouousin autō
verses.literal: And having been made perfect He became [the] source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him

verses.original: προσαγορευθεὶς ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀρχιερεὺς κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ
verses.transliteration: prosagoreutheis hypo tou Theou archiereus kata tēn taxin Melchisedek
verses.literal: [and] was designated by - God [as] high priest in the order of Melchizedek

verses.original: ἡμῖν πολὺς ὁ λόγος Περὶ οὗ καὶ δυσερμήνευτος λέγειν ἐπεὶ γεγόνατε νωθροὶ ταῖς ἀκοαῖς
verses.transliteration: hēmin polys ho logos Peri hou kai dysermēneutos legein epei gegonate nōthroi tais akoais
verses.literal: We [have] much - to say about [this] [but it is] hard to explain . . . because you are dull of hearing

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ διὰ τὸν χρόνον ὀφείλοντες εἶναι διδάσκαλοι ἔχετε χρείαν τοῦ διδάσκειν πάλιν ὑμᾶς τινα τὰ ἀρχῆς τῆς στοιχεῖα τῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ λογίων καὶ γεγόνατε ἔχοντες χρείαν γάλακτος καὶ οὐ στερεᾶς τροφῆς
verses.transliteration: gar kai dia ton chronon opheilontes einai didaskaloi echete chreian tou didaskein palin hymas tina ta archēs tēs stoicheia tōn tou Theou logiōn kai gegonate echontes chreian galaktos kai ou stereas trophēs
verses.literal: - Although by [this] time you ought to be teachers you need [someone] to reteach . . . you - the basic - principles - - of God’s word - vvv vvv You need milk - not solid food

verses.original: γὰρ πᾶς ὁ μετέχων γάλακτος γάρ ἐστιν νήπιος ἄπειρος λόγου δικαιοσύνης
verses.transliteration: gar pas ho metechōn galaktos gar estin nēpios apeiros logou dikaiosynēs
verses.literal: For everyone who lives on milk - is [still] an infant inexperienced in [the] message of righteousness

verses.original: δέ στερεὰ ἡ τροφή ἐστιν τελείων τῶν διὰ τὴν ἕξιν ἐχόντων γεγυμνασμένα τὰ αἰσθητήρια πρὸς διάκρισιν τε καλοῦ καὶ κακοῦ
verses.transliteration: de sterea hē trophē estin teleiōn tōn dia tēn hexin echontōn gegymnasmena ta aisthētēria pros diakrisin te kalou kai kakou
verses.literal: But solid - food is [for the] mature who by - constant use have trained [their] senses to distinguish . . . good [from] evil
